cleanup.detail: The local fixture's own shutdown endpoint returned 204 and its finally handler reported cleanup. API/proxy ports were idle, disposable PostgreSQL schema count was zero, and the isolated WSL attachment directory, frozen bundle, fixture script and Go binaries were removed. The agent-created Chrome tab was not manually closed after Computer Use stopped; it is ephemeral and subject to automatic turn cleanup. The 464-byte synthetic PNG remains in Windows Temp. The three Windows Temp files from the earlier QA-05 packet were not touched, and no previously rejected deletion or Chrome-profile-launch action was retried.

remaining_gate: QA-05 remains open. Repeat valid-PNG browser upload and check TEXT/DM preview/download and third-participant ACL in an allowed browser environment; no product preview outcome is established by this blocked attempt.
